title: The effects of a mobile pre-learning system with surface learning approach on academic achievement and mobile learning attitude
reason: Pretest-posttest non-equivalent control-group quasi-experiment: ANCOVA of achievement and comparison of mobile-learning attitude between groups; video viewing in the mobile pre-learning system is not measured per student or related to outcomes.

extraction.design: quasi-experimental pretest-posttest with non-equivalent control group (ANCOVA)
extraction.n_quote: Materials/methods – The research was conducted with 135 university
extraction.population: university students in an Instructional Technologies course, Canakkale Onsekiz Mart University
extraction.outcome_or_construct: academic achievement test; mobile learning attitude scale
extraction.notes: Secondary NOREL for the attitude scale (self-report). Effects are group-membership effects.
